# pvecli ct migrate

Migrate a container to another node of the cluster.

Containers cannot move live: a running one needs --restart (or a yes at
the prompt), which stops it, moves it and starts it again on the target.

```text
pvecli ct migrate [CTID] [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTID` | CT ID. |
| `TARGET` | Target node (menu when omitted). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--restart` | Stop a running container, move it and start it again. |
| `-t`, `--timeout N` | Shutdown timeout in seconds for --restart. |
| `--target-storage VALUE` | Storage on the target, or a source:target mapping. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli ct migrate 200 pve2
pvecli ct migrate 200 pve2 --restart
```
